connecting.title: Setting up your conversation
connecting.body: This takes a few seconds. The assistant will open the conversation.
connecting.slow: Still working — a slow connection can make this take a little longer.

home.title: Submit a report
home.subtitle: Choose how you want to proceed with your submission.

password.title: Secure credentials
password.body: Create a password to encrypt your report. You'll need it to check for updates.
password.warningBody: If you lose your password, your report cannot be recovered. We do not store passwords in plain text.

credentials.createdBody: Your secure ID has been generated. Download or copy these details now.

chat.languageBadgeTitle: Language for this conversation. End the session to change it.
chat.textTitle: The assistant replies silently, in text
chat.languageQuestion: Which language should we talk in?
chat.howCanIHelp: How can I help you today?
chat.sessionCleared: Session cleared. How can I help you today?

filed.title: Report filed
filed.writeDown: Write down your report number and password now — the assistant is reading them out, and the password is never stored where it can be recovered.

submitted.title: Report submitted
submitted.body: Your report has been filed and is now with the compliance team. Nothing further is needed from you right now.
submitted.accountNote: This report is filed under your account — sign in with this number to follow it. Keep the number somewhere safe.
submitted.anonymousNote: You will need this number and the password the assistant read out. The password is never stored, so it cannot be sent to you again — keep the copy you wrote down somewhere safe.

composer.waitForAssistant: Wait for the assistant to finish
composer.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verify important details.

account.fetchedBody: Your report number is ready. Download or copy it now.
account.loginBody: Log in to your account to continue.

handoff.title: Sign in to continue your report
handoff.bodyShort: The assistant reopens once you're signed in.
handoff.bodyLong: Use the form on this page. The assistant opens again as soon as you're signed in.

errors.staffAccount: You are signed in to a staff account. Log out to file a report.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.initFailed: Could not start the report. Please try again.
errors.invalidAccessToken: Your session is no longer valid. Please log in again.
errors.switchModeFailed: Could not switch modes. Try again.
errors.copyFailed: Could not copy — please write it down
errors.reportNotStarted: No report number yet. Please start a report first.
errors.authUnclear: Could not confirm how you are signed in. Please reload the page.
errors.tryAgainPickLanguage: {{error}} Pick a language to try again.
